name: Broadcast
overview: TV-like broadcast channel from your libraries with optional ad breaks, IPTV playlist and XMLTV guide.
description: Broadcast generates a continuous, TV-style channel from your Jellyfin libraries with optional commercials. Includes IPTV playlist (M3U) and XMLTV EPG endpoints.

versions.changelog: - Initial public version with schedule generation, thumbnails, IPTV (M3U, XMLTV), diagnostics endpoints.
